build_visualizer_for_image: build a Visualizer instance from an RGB numpy image and dataset metadata to draw annotations
draw_instance_predictions: draw instance-level prediction results including boxes, masks, keypoints, and labels on an image
draw_semantic_segmentation: draw semantic segmentation predictions with colored masks and class labels on an image
draw_panoptic_segmentation: draw panoptic segmentation results combining semantic stuff and instance thing masks on an image
draw_dataset_dict: draw all annotations from a Detectron2 dataset dictionary including boxes, masks, and segmentation
